question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Did you want to join the MAN frat?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Okay, so this circle here is the lake in front of us... And this line over here is one of the hiking trails.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: So that means we've just got to follow along the lake until we hit that trail, right?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah, exactly!
After a few hours of walking...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: We're here!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Hey, you kids actually made it back.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Not bad. Not bad at all.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: I've got a lot of faith in this pledge class. Now get some rest.
The next day, you and Bryce head to class in the science building. Half the room is taken up with desks, and the other half has lab equipment.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Okay, we've got this. Look, the stuff in the beaker's already starting to foam.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Nice.

nodes.speaker: Professor Carnine
nodes.text: The two of you. What were your names? Bryce and $USR, right?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: That's right.

nodes.speaker: Professor Carnine
nodes.text: Since you're the first two to finish the experiment, I'm letting both of you into the class.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Professor Carnine
nodes.text: Just keep up the good work.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Whoa! Is that supposed to be bubbling?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I think the fire's too high! I'll grab it!
You grab the hot beaker with your bare hands...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Ow ow ow!
You drop it, and the beaker explodes, sending glass flying through the air!

nodes.speaker: Professor Carnine
nodes.text: Get out of the room! Evacuate!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Uh, maybe we should drop this class.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah, I never liked science, anyway.
You and Bryce quietly crawl through the window and end up in the showers.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yes! We're in!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Shh!
You and the other pledges grab every cupcake, cookie, and pie in sight!

nodes.speaker: Nelson
nodes.text: We're pantry-raiding ninjas.

nodes.speaker: Mike
nodes.text: This has got to be the most delicious prank in the history of MAN.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Now let's get out of here so we can reap the rewards of our plundering.
You sprint out of OMG and back to the MAN house with the rest of the pledges behind you.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Come on, guys! We're almost there!
When you get to the den, you pile all the food in front of the brothers.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Not bad, pledges! Not bad!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Heh. You know, I think there's even enough here for us to share with you guys.
The pledge class spends the next few hours eating with Chuck and James.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Ah, the spoils of war.

nodes.speaker: Mike
nodes.text: Mmm! Delicious booty.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Good work, boys. I've got a lot of faith in this pledge class. Now get some rest.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Overall, the brothers and I talked about everything you've all done this week...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Unfortunately, $USR, you're not exactly MAN material.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but you just don't seem like you've got your act together. College is tough, and MAN brothers have to set a good example.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: And I just don't think you can live up to the high standards we have.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: But Bryce?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: You're exactly what we're looking for in a MAN man.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Awesome.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: But come on, Bryce. Let's introduce you to the rest of the brothers! You've got a bright future ahead of you here!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Sweet!
Yikes! Looks like $USR fell short!
If only things had gone a little better during the week... Maybe things would be different.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: I hate to say it, but $USR was a total failure. He couldn't handle getting dropped in the forest, and he couldn't pull off the OMG prank.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: And I heard you really messed up during football tryouts... Coach Graw said you were one of the worst players he's ever seen.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: But how'd the rush events go? I know $USR must have stepped it up for those.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: According to our sources, you're not doing so great in your classes.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Whatever. You should have helped when you had the chance.
Beth turns and leaves.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You okay, man? That looked rough.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah... I feel terrible.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Well, well. If it isn't the boys who stole from our charity bake sale.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Er... Sorry about that.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hey, I thought you were boycotting all the MAN parties for the rest of the semester.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: We're banning `you` from `our` parties. That doesn't mean we can't come here and enjoy your food and drinks.
nodes.text_bbcode: We're banning [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] from [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] parties. That doesn't mean we can't come here and enjoy your food and drinks.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: But all of the OMG sisters have `strict` orders to not get involved with any of you.
nodes.text_bbcode: But all of the OMG sisters have [color=#3b78e2][i]strict[/i][/color] orders to not get involved with any of you.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Great...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Now if you'll excuse me, I have some guys to talk to who `didn't` sabotage our efforts to help those in need.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now if you'll excuse me, I have some guys to talk to who [color=#3b78e2][i]didn't[/i][/color] sabotage our efforts to help those in need.

nodes.text: Tina turns and leaves.
You turn to see Chuck heading over.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Hey, guys. Tonight's the big night. I can't wait to talk to James and see how you two did.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Oh, man, I really hope we made it.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Only one way to find out. Hey! James!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Hey, Chuck. There you are, $USR. I bet you're wondering what the brothers thought of you.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Well, I'll give it to you straight.
That night, you and Bryce go to the MAN frat party.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Lookin' sharp, $USR.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Now, who wants to play pool? We might as well enjoy the party before we find out whether or not we made the fraternity.

nodes.speaker: Mike
nodes.text: I'm in! Let's do it.

nodes.speaker: Nelson
nodes.text: I'm starting up a game of ping pong! Loser has to run around the building in their underwear!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I'm totally in! $USR, are you with me?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: 'We'?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey, we both helped make this mess. In fact, I bet we could get a lot of the other pledges to help.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Really? I think people have better things to do than bake cupcakes all day...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Think about it. OMG throws the best parties on campus, and they've got the hottest girls...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I know the guys won't be thrilled, but no way they'd be dumb enough to want the whole sorority mad at them.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Haha. I guess you're right!
A few hours and a few hundred cupcakes and cookies later...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Ugh, I can't believe you talked me into helping you with this.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey, man, think of the parties. `Think of the parties!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, man, think of the parties. [color=#e23b3b][i]Think of the parties![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mike
nodes.text: He's right. We need to do this.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Thank you guys for making things right. I really appreciate this.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Of course. Hope Tina won't hold it against you now.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: But... What am I going to do?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Sorry, but I don't know how to bake.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Fine! I'll handle this myself!
Beth storms out.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I hope that didn't sound too harsh...
Later that day...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Hey! Pledge! I just got a call from Tina. You made one of the OMG girls cry?!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uh... Maybe.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Not cool, man. Part of the tradition for these fraternity pranks is making up for it so the girls don't hold it against us!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Now Tina's saying that she won't let anyone from MAN into the OMG parties for the rest of the semester!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: And the OMG girls are the `hottest` on campus, $USR. The `hottest.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And the OMG girls are the [color=#e23b3b][i]hottest[/i][/color] on campus, $USR. The [color=#e23b3b][i]hottest.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Getting us cut out of those parties? That's going to count against you.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Great... I really should have helped Beth.
You and the other pledges grab as many desserts as you can hold...
But as you run out of the OMG house, you drop one of the cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hey, watch it!
Bryce steps on the cupcake and slips, running into you!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Oof!
The other pledges collide into you! The desserts fall everywhere!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Not the chocolate cake! Nooo!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: What a waste.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Come on, guys, staring isn't going to save that food.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: So let me get this straight...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: You ruined `all` the desserts?! `All` of them?!
nodes.text_bbcode: You ruined [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] the desserts?! [color=#e23b3b][i]All[/i][/color] of them?!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: This... This is a sad day.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Now get out of here.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Let's just get out of here and let the guys in.
A few minutes later, you're standing in a room filled with the most delicious cakes, cupcakes, cookies, and pies that you've ever seen.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Whoa! This place is magical!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey, stay focused.
You and Bryce head to the front door and turn off the sorority's alarm system.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Okay, that should do it! Let's get the guys in here.
The pledges slowly file into the kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Nelson
nodes.text: Yes! We did it!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Don't get cocky yet. We've still got to get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Right. So far so good, but now we need to get all of this stuff out of here without dropping it.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hurry!
You and Bryce dive into the shower and pull the curtain shut just as Tina storms in.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Hey! Is someone in that shower?
You turn on the water and try to speak in the highest-pitched voice you can manage.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: 'Goodness! Is someone there?'

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Oh. Never mind!
Tina turns and walks out, muttering to herself...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I guess it was just someone taking a late shower.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Quick thinking, man. But... If you didn't notice, now we're soaking wet.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Desperate times, man. Desperate measures.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Well, let's get as dry as we can and get out of here.
You and Bryce dive into one of the bathroom stalls.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Oof! Get your own stall!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: It's too late now...
The door to the bathroom opens...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Hey! Is someone in here?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Hellooo?
Tina spots the open window.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Grrr, those girls don't understand `anything` about security!
nodes.text_bbcode: Grrr, those girls don't understand [color=#3b78e2][i]anything[/i][/color] about security!

nodes.text: Tina locks the window and leaves, slamming the door behind her.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Whew... That was close.
As you climb through, your foot slips! You crash into Bryce, and the two of you fall through the window and end up in the showers!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Ow ow ow! I think I broke my foot! Agghhh! I've never been in so much pain!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hey, man up! Someone's going to hear you.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: But... The pain!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Don't be such a baby! Shh!
That night, you hear someone pounding on your door!
Bryce stumbles over and opens it.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Up and at 'em, pledges!
A few minutes later, the pledge class is assembled at the MAN house.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: We've got a little tradition for you boys. Every year, the MAN pledge class pulls a prank on the OMG pledge class.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: And this year, as you might know, the OMG girls are getting ready for a `huge` bake sale.
nodes.text_bbcode: And this year, as you might know, the OMG girls are getting ready for a [color=#e23b3b][i]huge[/i][/color] bake sale.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: They've got cupcakes, cookies, and even pies.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: So we want you to pull off a pantry raid. Go liberate those baked goods and bring them back for the glory of MAN!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Now get going, pledges. We're hungry.
A few minutes later, outside the OMG house...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Now, sorority girls have to be used to frat pranks. I'll bet they've got some security in place.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: If we're not careful, we'll set off a shrill, high-pitched, shrieking noise...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: And then there's also the alarm.

nodes.speaker: Mike
nodes.text: So how do we get in?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Someone's got to go through one of the unlocked windows on the second floor. We need one person to hold the window, and then another to squeeze through.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Once inside, we can disable the alarm and get everyone in and out, no problem.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Sounds risky. Who're the lucky ones who get to climb up there?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hey, I'd do it by myself if I could. But it's a two-man operation. So who's going to step up?

nodes.speaker: Mike
nodes.text: Uh... I've kind of got a bad back...

nodes.speaker: Nelson
nodes.text: I'm not great with heights...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: `Come on!` I'm offering you the chance to sneak into a sorority!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Come on![/i][/color] I'm offering you the chance to sneak into a sorority!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Whatever. $USR, you with me?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. I had a feeling it would end up this way. Let's go.
That afternoon, you run into Bryce.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey! What was with sending me to that class?!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Heh heh. Sorry, man. It was too good to pass up. How'd it go?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: The class isn't the point! That girl basically hates me!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hey, there's a fine line between love and hate, man.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah, whatever.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Wrong!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: You're a terrible husband!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: How could you do this to me and the kids?!
After ten more minutes of the awkward exercise, Tina lets you sit down.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: That was so humiliating...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: What have I gotten myself into? I never should have come to this class.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Huh. That's right.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I mean, you really remembered our anniversary?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Of course! I got a reservation for us at that fancy French restaurant down the street.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: But... What about the kids?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I hired a sitter.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: What about the woman you're cheating on me with?!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: That was all a big misunderstanding.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: $USR, I'm not sure you understand the point of this exercise.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey, if you can make things up, so can I.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Oh, whatever. Let's move on to the next discussion topic.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Tina might not like me, but at least I beat her at her own game.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Wrong!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: You're a terrible husband!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: How could you do this to me and the kids?!
After ten more minutes of the awkward exercise, Tina lets you sit down.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: That was so humiliating...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: What have I gotten myself into? I never should have come to this class.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Wrong!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: You're a terrible husband!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: How could you do this to me and the kids?!
After ten more minutes of the awkward exercise, Tina lets you sit down.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: That was so humiliating...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: What have I gotten myself into? I never should have come to this class.
That night...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Huh, I still need to find one more class to take.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Oh, I've got an idea... Why don't you take this 'The Philosophy of Love' class? Sounds like an easy 'A'.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Are you taking it?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Nah, I'm busy. But let me know how it goes.
The next day, you head to the section for 'The Philosophy of Love'...

nodes.speaker: Nelson
nodes.text: Hey, $USR. You're in this class too?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah, it sounded fun.

nodes.speaker: Nelson
nodes.text: Right. And I heard the TA's totally hot...
The TA walks in.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Hello, everyone. I'm Tina. I'll be your TA this quarter.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Tina?! Bryce set me up!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Oh, looks like we've got a little MAN pledge here. Looking for an easy 'A', huh?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uh, no! Of course not!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Right. Sure. Well, class, let's get started today by role-playing some real-life situations and seeing how some of you would react...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Let me pick someone totally at random...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Hey, you. I don't think I caught your name when you were lurking around the OMG house.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Me? I'm $USR.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Okay, $USR. Today's topic of discussion is fidelity. Let's start our discussion by doing a role-play exercise for a long-term relationship.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uh... Okay.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: We've been married for six years, we've got three kids, you work 80 hours a week so you're never home, and I just caught you cheating on me.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Okay, `go.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [color=#3b78e2][i]go.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: $USR! I can't believe you'd do this to me and the kids!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I can't believe I wasted so many good years on you! How could you do this on our anniversary?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I bet you don't even remember how many years we've been together, do you?

nodes.prompt: I bet you don't even remember how many years we've been together, do you?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I bet you don't even remember how many years we've been together, do you?

nodes.text: You lose! Bryce walks up and takes his helmet off.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: What happened?! I thought we had that...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I guess we need some more practice.

nodes.speaker: Coach Graw
nodes.text: Pathetic! Just pathetic! I've seen punching bags put up more of a fight!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: So... We didn't make the team?

nodes.speaker: Coach Graw
nodes.text: Make the team?! The only way I'd let you `near` this team is if we needed more practice tackle dummies!
nodes.text_bbcode: Make the team?! The only way I'd let you [color=#e23b3b][i]near[/i][/color] this team is if we needed more practice tackle dummies!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Gulp!

nodes.speaker: Coach Graw
nodes.text: But lucky for you, we already have enough dummies! Now get out of here!
Coach Graw storms off!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Sorry, guys. I guess you're not making the team.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Man, I really hope we've got a shot at this. I mean, we couldn't even beat Wilson High... Are we really good enough to make the team?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Hey, you guys have been practicing, right? And, I mean, anything's possible...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: We'll just have to really step it up.
The next afternoon, you and Bryce run up to the football field...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Hey, you guys are just in time.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Oh, man, your grades were worse than mine in high school... I hope we can pull this off.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Gulp.
And there are already over fifty students crowded around the lab tables!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Whoa! It's totally packed. I guess `everyone` heard that Professor Carnine was the easiest science teacher.
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! It's totally packed. I guess [color=#e23b3b][i]everyone[/i][/color] heard that Professor Carnine was the easiest science teacher.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Were we... Supposed to sign up for this class?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Uh...
Just then, the professor walks into the room.

nodes.speaker: Professor Carnine
nodes.text: Hello, new students! I'm Professor Carnine, and as you've probably noticed, this class is much too full.

nodes.speaker: Professor Carnine
nodes.text: If you already registered for the class, you're safe.

nodes.speaker: Professor Carnine
nodes.text: But according to the registrar, we've only got ten spaces left for all you unregistered students.

nodes.speaker: Professor Carnine
nodes.text: So write your names down if you haven't registered, and we'll start with an experiment to see who can make the cut.
Mr. Carnine starts writing down the steps to the experiment on the board.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Man, we've really got to make it into this class.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I think... Maybe... We should go left?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You're holding the map upside down! We need to go right!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: We're never getting out of here...
As the sun rises over the lake, the pledge class is still lost in the woods...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: This is hopeless!
Suddenly, James pops out of a nearby bush!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Pathetic. Just pathetic.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: I've never seen a pledge class fail so `horribly.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I've never seen a pledge class fail so [color=#e23b3b][i]horribly.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: But... It was dark... We were lost...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: None of you deserve a ride back to civilization, but charter rules prevent me from leaving you out here to die.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Come on... Get in the van.
James drives the pledge class back to the MAN frat house on campus.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Now get out of here. This group is a disgrace to all MAN kind.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yawn!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: It's going to be a long day...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah...
Only a few short hours later, you and Bryce head to class in the science building.
Half the room is taken up with desks, and the other half has lab equipment...

nodes.speaker: Nelson
nodes.text: Anyone know how to tell where we are on it?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I'll give it my best shot...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
